name: remove-unused-apex
description: Find the Apex a Salesforce org can safely remove: select dependency-complete packages toward the customer's capacity target, collect package rulings, and hand back dependency-ordered removal and annotation stories. Analysis only; the customer executes every change.

interface.shortDescription: Find the Apex your Salesforce org can safely remove.
interface.longDescription: A guided playbook that uses Elements execution telemetry and the dependency graph to find Apex classes and triggers with no recorded use, selects dependency-complete packages toward your capacity target, records your remove, keep, annotate, or decide-later rulings, and hands back removal and annotation stories. Analysis only: you make every change. Needs the Elements.cloud plugin and its connection.
defaultPrompt: Find the Apex my org can safely remove.
We're near the Apex character limit. What can we reclaim?
